name: switchboard-for-claude-code
description: A board of every Claude Code session on this machine: who needs you, who is waiting for your reply, who wants a new session, who is done, with each one's context and cost, and a to-do list of what Claude asked you to do. Click a session to jump to its terminal tab, and get a push on your phone when one needs you while you are away.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: The path to the claude command is only read from user settings.

commands.title: Set the Board to Its Default Width
Send a Test Push to My Phone

switchboard.popups.needsYou.description: Show a pop-up when a session starts waiting for you (a permission prompt or a question).

switchboard.popups.finished.description: Show a pop-up when a session finishes a turn while you are looking elsewhere.

switchboard.popups.finishedMinSeconds.description: Only pop up for finished turns that ran at least this many seconds.

switchboard.phonePush.needsYou.description: Send a phone push when a session starts waiting for you (a permission prompt or a question). Run "Switchboard: Set Up Phone Push" first; until then nothing is sent.

switchboard.phonePush.finished.description: Send a phone push when a session finishes a turn: done, waiting for your reply, handing over, or stopped on an error.

switchboard.phonePush.finishedMinSeconds.description: Only push for finished turns that ran at least this many seconds.

enumDescriptions: Only while you are away from this computer (see Away Minutes). A session that needs you just before you leave is pushed once you have been away that long, unless you dealt with it first.
Every time, unless you are looking at that session's tab.
switchboard.phonePush.when.description: When to send a phone push.

switchboard.phonePush.awayMinutes.description: How long you must have been away before a push is sent. On macOS this is time since your last key press or mouse move; elsewhere, time since any VS Code window had focus.

switchboard.phonePush.quoteClaude.description: Quote Claude's question or error in the push. Off, a push says only the session's title, its folder and what happened, because pushes pass through the ntfy server.

switchboard.newSessionTokens.description: Suggest starting a new session once a finished session's context reaches this many tokens. 0 turns it off. A reply that hands over with a kickoff prompt is always suggested.

switchboard.board.width.description: The board's width in pixels. The side bar is widened to it the first time the board opens, and again whenever this setting changes; after that, drag its edge as usual. Run "Switchboard: Set the Board to Its Default Width" to go back to it. 0 leaves the side bar alone.

switchboard.showCost.description: Show what each session's tokens would cost at Anthropic's API prices, helper agents included. On a Claude plan this is not what you pay.

switchboard.todos.fromReplies.description: Add to your to-do list what Claude's replies ask of you (lines such as "Needs you: …" or "**You:** …", and the list under a heading such as "Needs you"), and clear each ask once the session's next reply no longer makes it.

switchboard.newSession.chooseModel.description: Ask for the model and the effort, as the last two questions, before starting a session (New session, and Start next session). Each list opens on your last choice; "Default" leaves it to your Claude Code settings. A summary to confirm always comes last.

switchboard.startNext.sameTab.description: Start next session ends the old session and starts the new one in its terminal tab, when that tab is in this window and the old session is not working. The old session's history is kept (claude --resume reopens it). Off: the new session opens in a tab of its own and the old one stays open.

switchboard.statusBar.enabled.description: Show the session counter in the status bar.

switchboard.claudePath.description: Absolute path to the claude command. Leave empty to find it on PATH or in ~/.local/bin. Only read from user settings, never from a workspace.
